channel.desc: A man in Richland County, SC leads police on a vehicle pursuit that ends when he crashes into a highway exit sign; a female employee at a local restaurant in Tallahassee, FL allegedly stabs a customer in the back four times before being apprehended by police; neighbors in Citrus County, FL get into an argument about their dogs that ends with a chihuahua being cut with a knife.
